answer: An identity earns its seat through peer review of identity claims, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. Cloning 754 keys multiplies the price 754-fold: 69368 POA locked, or 9802 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. What carries the harbor here is verification, the relic of cost is what stops the farm, and the ivory of the record keeps every claim checkable. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
